caseName: Atlantic Coast Line Railroad v. Brotherhood of Railway Trainmen
caseNameFull: ATLANTIC COAST LINE RAILROAD CO. v. BROTHERHOOD OF RAILWAY TRAINMEN
attorneys: Paul A. Porter and Dennis G. Lyons argued the cause for petitioners. With them on the briefs were Abe Krash and Daniel A. Rezneck., Neal Rutledge and Allan Milledge argued the cause for respondents. With them on the brief was Lester P. Schoene.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The judgment is affirmed by an equally divided Court.

Mr. Justice Fortas took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
